captions.caption: A man uses a primitive stone axe to chop a tree.
He strikes the tree trunk repeatedly with the tool.
The man continues his effort to fell the tree.
Wood chips are visible as he chops into the bark.
He maintains a steady rhythm with the stone axe.
A close-up shows the stone tool hitting the tree.
The man uses both hands to swing the primitive axe.
He focuses his strikes on a specific section of the trunk.
The cut in the tree becomes deeper with each blow.
The man continues the laborious task of chopping.
He swings the wooden pole with the stone tip again.
The primitive tool is effective at removing wood.
He continues to strike the tree at the same height.
The man is shown working from a different angle.
He finishes another round of chopping at the base.
A man carries a large wooden pole on his shoulder.
He walks past a brick wall under construction.
The man carries the pole through the forest clearing.
He approaches the area where he will store the wood.
He drops the heavy wooden pole onto the ground.
The pole settles next to other building materials.
Two men walk through the woods carrying poles.
They walk past a circular stone structure.
One man carries a long pole over his shoulders.
They move towards the construction site.
The men are almost at their destination.
They prepare to unload the wooden poles.
One man drops his pole onto the existing pile.
The pole lands with a thud on the dirt.
They have collected several poles for their work.
The men stand together near the pile of wood.
One man reaches down to move a piece of wood.
They are surrounded by trees and primitive structures.
A man begins to work with a long vine on the ground.
He lays the vine out straight in the clearing.
His companion joins him to help manage the vine.
They both hold and pull the long natural rope.
The men walk along the vine to inspect its length.
They continue to prepare the vine for construction.
The men move the vine closer to the stone well.
They handle the vine carefully as they walk.
One man holds the vine while the other adjusts it.
They are preparing to use the vine as a binding material.
The men are now working on a bundle of vines.
They begin to braid the vines together into a rope.
They work closely to ensure the braid is tight.
The men are focused on their manual labor task.
One man bends down to work on the vine on the ground.
He uses a sharp stone to trim the vine material.
The man continues to refine the vine with the stone.
He carefully removes outer layers from the vine.
The second man assists by holding the vine steady.
They continue the process of making the rope.
The man uses the stone tool to slice the vine.
He works diligently on the long piece of vine.
Both men are kneeling while they work on the ground.
They check the flexibility of the prepared vine.
The man strikes the vine with the stone tool.
They continue to process the natural fibers together.
The men are making good progress on the vine rope.
